column2: Paano mag-add ng foreign key sa table?
column4: CREATE TABLE orders (id INT, user_id INT, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id));

column2: Paano mag-set ng ON DELETE CASCADE?
column4: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE — auto-delete child rows

column2: Paano mag-set ng ON DELETE SET NULL?
column4: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL — i-set ang FK sa NULL

column2: Paano i-check ang foreign keys sa table?
column4: SHOW CREATE TABLE orders; — ipapakita ang lahat ng constraints kasama ang foreign keys
ALTER TABLE orders DROP FOREIGN KEY orders_ibfk_1; — gamitin ang ALTER TABLE DROP FOREIGN KEY
